applies_to: OJ Electronics GreenZone ZoneMaster demand-controlled ventilation masters with software 3.47, including their ZoneModules.
summary: The OJ GreenZone ZoneMaster coordinates up to 25 ZoneModules (room VAV, valve and sensor controllers) and the air handling unit for demand-controlled ventilation. Its EDE lists AHU and section values, then a fixed block of about 59 objects for each of ZoneModules 1-25: room and supply temperatures, CO2/VOC and RH, VAV flows and damper positions, valve outputs, setpoints and alarm bitmaps.
notes: Built from the installer EDE export (67851, 06-07-2020). The EDE has no read/write column, units or descriptions, so access is inferred (AV/BV writable, AI/BI read-only) and units are blank.
Each ZoneModule n uses its own instance block (ZoneModule 1 = 1000-range, ZoneModule 9 = 1800-range); objects for zone modules that are not installed will read nothing useful.
ZoneMaster 1-5 local alarm status sits on AI 4000, 4100, 4200, 4300 and 4400.
The EDE does not say which BACnet transport the controller uses; check it on site.

source.title: OJ GreenZone ZoneControl EDE file (installer), v3.47

integration.summary: To drive the system from the BMS, set BV 110 to take digital inputs from the BMS, then use BV 103 (start), BV 105 / BV 106 (max / min air) and BV 104 (fire). Read AI 111 and AI 104 for operation and AHU status, each ZoneModule's room temperature and alarm bitmaps, and AI 109 for the section alarm.

minimum_points.name: Enable Digital Input Values from BMS
minimum_points.why: Use BMS values instead of the digital inputs

minimum_points.name: DIN Max Air (BMS)
minimum_points.why: Max air command from the BMS

minimum_points.name: DIN Min Air (BMS)
minimum_points.why: Min air command from the BMS

minimum_points.name: ZoneMaster Operation Mode
minimum_points.why: Current operating mode of the zone system

minimum_points.name: AHU status
minimum_points.why: Status of the air handling unit

integration.enable: Going by the object names, BV 110 (Enable Digital Input Values from BMS) has to be on before the BMS input values BV 103-109 (start, fire, max/min air, summer night cooling) are used. The EDE has no further explanation.
setup: The EDE gives device instance 22020 and device name OJ-ZoneMaster.
gotchas: The EDE is a full map for 25 ZoneModules; only the installed ones carry data.
Alarm bitmaps (AI xx25-xx28 per zone) must be split into bits.
